Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Recap & next steps — Clearline inference expansion discussion

Hi Samantha / Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so everything is on the same page. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes on peak days (page-load-sensitive flows) — p95 spikes ~2.1s, target <700ms for customer-facing completions.
- Costs scaling with the nightly batch processing for your RAG pipelines (current embedding spend and token usage is driving unit economics).
- Need for predictable capacity for Q1 launches (clinical triage and patient messaging) with data segregation requirements for PHI-adjacent logs.

Current usage we reviewed
- Monthly generation tokens: ~1.2B tokens (90-day trailing).
- Embedding calls: ~6M embeddings/month (embedding model: text-embedding-3-small).
- Peak concurrent requests: ~480 streams during peak business hours.

Proposed upsell / pilot path (high level)
1) Dedicated pilot: reserve a small Dedicated pool (4x A100-equivalent) for your production-friendly endpoints — reduces p95 by ~40-60% in similar accounts.
2) Optimize recommendations: enable prefix/KV caching for RAG caches, dynamic batching on user-facing endpoints, and evaluate int8 quantization on the ranking model to cut costs ~30% while preserving accuracy.
3) Governance & compliance: we’ll provision a VPC-connected Private control plane for audit logs and KMS integration for key handling during the pilot.

Timeline (target)
- Jan 10 — pilot kickoff (env + model pinning + routing policy).
- Jan 10–Feb 7 (4 weeks) — ramp and performance validation (latency & cost benchmarks).
- Feb 15 — contract signature for Dedicated capacity if pilot meets SLAs.

Action items we committed to
- Logan: send a short Mutual Action Plan and draft SOW (attached) by EOD today.
- Marissa: provide a pricing worksheet with committed vs burst capacity comparisons (attached).
- Diego: scope the KV cache approach and a short tech-runbook for integration (will follow with a design doc).
- Samantha / Evan: confirm data residency constraints and list any additional compliance paperwork needed.

Attachments included: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.pdf

Open questions for you
- Are there additional latency-sensitive endpoints beyond the triage workflow we should account for?
- Any procurement windows or PO cadence we should be aware of in January/February?

Thanks — looking forward to running this pilot with you. If Jan 10 is tight we can shift to Jan 17; either way we should lock a kickoff meeting this week.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearlinehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Clearline inference expansion discussion

Logan —

Appreciate the clear summary. This matches our notes. A few quick clarifications and asks before we lock dates: 

1) Pricing sensitivity: our CFO is most focused on reducing per-embedding cost and capping overall monthly spikes. Can Marissa include a 12-month committed option with a clear breakout for embedding vs generation usage?

2) Compliance: we do need SOC 2 in-scope evidence and a short summary of how audit logs will be retained for 12 months. PHI will not be sent directly but we do handle some patient-identifiable metadata — KMS integration and retention policies are important.

3) Data residency: primary workloads remain US-based, but procurement wants an explicit note that backups and logs will not be replicated to EU without consent.

4) Pilot kickoff: Jan 10 looks good for our engineering leads. Can you propose two 60-min slots (Jan 10 morning PT and Jan 12 afternoon PT) so Evan and our platform folks can join?

5) Procurement: looping in procurement for PO cadence. We generally process POs on a 30–45 day timeline once terms and SOW are agreed.

If you can provide the revised pricing worksheet + SOC2 summary and the mutual action plan, we'll route internally. Also please flag anything in the SOW that you expect to be redlined.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Integrations | Clearline Health
